nodes.label: worktree-unification build-plan task package (spec/plan/tasks/data-contracts)
nodes.rationale: The artifact under review across all rounds: a build-plan package for unifying task worktree/material storage, repeatedly revised (rounds r7-r14) until pass.

nodes.label: FR-WORKTREE-COMMIT-004: per-stage/per-phase commit coverage matrix
nodes.rationale: Spec requires every pipeline stage/phase (make-decision, build-spec, build-plan, build-code per phase, verify-code, close) to produce a commit or a no-change record, so stage artifacts stay traceable; tasks repeatedly failed to land the full matrix.

nodes.label: Forbidden-file conflict: build-spec/build-plan SKILL.md read-only vs minimal-edit
nodes.rationale: plan.md marked workflows/build-spec/SKILL.md and workflows/build-plan/SKILL.md as forbidden/read-only while T005 allowed minimal edits to them, giving implementers contradictory instructions; persisted across rounds and drove escalation.

nodes.label: stage-result filename contract conflict (stage-result.json vs stage-result-verify-code.json)
nodes.rationale: spec.md FR-WORKTREE-CLOSE-006 required {{task_tracking_root}}/tasks/{task-id}/stage-result.json while T006 wrote stage-result-verify-code.json and plan.md mixed both; without one authoritative filename close verdict evidence becomes untraceable.

nodes.label: FR-WORKTREE-SCOPE-009: specs/{task-id}/ storage boundary
nodes.rationale: Spec allows only spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md under specs/{task-id}/ while the repo directory held research.md, data-contracts.md, baseline-report.md, stage-result.json and more; process artifacts must live under task_tracking_root.

nodes.label: Fake-green / non-executable verification gates
nodes.rationale: Recurring blocker family: gates that grep document text instead of exercising behavior, swallow exit codes via pipes, treat grep exit 1 as pass, or only display counts (git worktree list | wc -l) without before/after comparison — all unable to distinguish real pass from false green.
